`describe.skip` declares a test group that is skipped.

issue_context.title: [Feature] add describe.skip
issue_context.body: Can we add `describe.skip`, since we already have `describe.only`?
comments: We also have `describe.parallel` and `describe.serial`, and I don't really want to introduce `describe.parallel.skip` and `describe.serial.skip`.
curious, what's wrong with adding `describe.serial.skip` when we also have `test.describe.serial.only`

review_comments: boring test! can we have some nesting?..
